title: Audit the bar: does the corpus cover world design, region character, landform/geology, road networks, and Black Marsh canon?
charge: OWNER-DIRECTIVES-2026-08-14 §6 — the reference corpus itself may be insufficient.
headline: Between-region differentiation is well covered and the built world clears it on merit. Within-region variety and landform/geology were absent from the corpus entirely; both now have an item and a working instrument. Measured baseline: 11 of 13 regions over target for unchanging-ground stretches; valus-ridge has a 312.5 s p90 run and a 79% modal ground state.
findings: RI-WLD04 M18: three of nine axes are 'any difference' set membership; the slope axis is a chi-square with no effect-size floor, which passes automatically at n>3000.
RI-WLD04 M19: ONLY-HERE elements need >=8 instances but no spatial spread — eight in one clump passes.
RI-WLD07 §4: verticality targets are world-aggregate. Shipped world's area-weighted mean slope is 10.07 deg (in band) while 7 of 13 regions are under 5.5 deg.
RI-WLD02 is region-blind: no requirement that regions differ in the KINDS of POI they hold. Morrowind's own place-type Jaccard runs 0.267-0.727 with 8 place types unique to a single region.
RI-WLD09 mandates >=240 s POI-free walks and nothing required the landscape to change during them. RI-WLD15 W15-7 closes this.
The canonical coast->interior gradient of Black Marsh is untested anywhere; a predicate is proposed for RI-LOR02 in the report §5.5, marked reversible.
Corpus-wide grep: 'geology', 'topography', 'geomorphology' appeared zero times before this task.

instrument_controls.m-wld15-monotony.mjs --selfcheck: exit 0 — uniform synthetic world fails, aperiodic varied world passes
instrument_controls.m-wld16-landform-census.mjs --selfcheck: exit 0 — 3 negative controls red (collapsed macro-forms, flat declared as ridge, generic-noun world), 3 positive green
instrument_controls.mine-regions.mjs --selfcheck: exit 0 — 4 probes, 3 of them negative controls
instrument_controls.note: m-wld16 L3 was briefly inert in the dangerous direction (word-level matcher reported 71% against a world containing none of the landforms); caught by adding a generic-noun negative control, honest figure is 5%.

measured.m-wld16: exit 1 — L1 PASS, L2 PASS, L3 FAIL at 3/65 landform elements present in world data

not_done: Arm B of RI-WLD15 (rendered walks) not run — needs a browser and visual-fidelity agents are live (rule 21). RI-WLD15 and RI-WLD16 should be scored not_run until a critic runs it.
RI-WLD04 M17 not run for the same reason.
